commands.help:
No encryption key found - Auto-generating and saving to: /home/node/.n8n/config
USAGE
  $ n8n export:entities

FLAGS
  -h, --help                           Show CLI help
  --outputDir                          Output directory path [default: /usr/local/lib/node_modules/n8n/dist/commands/export/outputs]
  --includeExecutionHistoryDataTables  Include execution history data tables, these are excluded by default as they can be very large [default: false]
  --includeDataTableRows               Include user-data table row contents. When false, only the data-table schemas (registry rows) are exported. [default: true]
  --keyFile <value>                    Optional path to a file containing a custom encryption key

DESCRIPTION
  Export database entities to JSON files

EXAMPLES
  $ n8n export:entities
  $ n8n export:entities --outputDir=./exports
  $ n8n export:entities --outputDir=/path/to/backup
  $ n8n export:entities --includeExecutionHistoryDataTables=true
  $ n8n export:entities --includeDataTableRows=false
  $ n8n export:entities --keyFile=/path/to/key.txt
  $ n8n export:entities --outputDir=./exports --keyFile=/path/to/key.txt

No encryption key found - Auto-generating and saving to: /home/node/.n8n/config
USAGE
  $ n8n import:entities

FLAGS
  -h, --help                           Show CLI help
  --inputDir                           Input directory that holds output files for import [default: ./outputs]
  --truncateTables                     Truncate tables before import [default: false]
  --keyFile <value>                    Optional path to a file containing a custom encryption key
  --skipMigrationChecks                Skip migration validation checks [default: false]
  --skipTogglingForeignKeyConstraints  Skip disabling foreign key constraints [default: false]

DESCRIPTION
  Import database entities from JSON files

EXAMPLES
  $ n8n import:entities
  $ n8n import:entities --inputDir=./exports
  $ n8n import:entities --inputDir=/path/to/backup
  $ n8n import:entities --truncateTables
  $ n8n import:entities --inputDir=./exports --truncateTables
  $ n8n import:entities --keyFile=/path/to/key.txt
  $ n8n import:entities --inputDir=./exports --keyFile=/path/to/key.txt
  $ n8n import:entities --skipMigrationChecks
  $ n8n import:entities --inputDir=./exports --skipMigrationChecks
